KeyPassages: Psalm 44:12; Proverbs 1:13; Song of Solomon 8:7; Ezekiel 27:12
BiblicalUsage: hôwn is a plain word for wealth, riches, enough. In Psalm 44:12, the text says "and dost not increase [thy wealth] by their price." In Ezekiel 27:12, the text says "Tarshish [was] thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all [kind of] riches."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hôwn matters because money is a tool, not a master — it serves us when God is first, and it rules us when He is not. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
